Exploring the top musical masterminds across the country:

1. The Global Icon: A.R. Rahman

Known as the "Mozart of Madras," Rahman revolutionized Indian film music by blending classical melodies with electronic and world sounds. He is India's most decorated composer, holding two Academy Awards (Oscars) and multiple Grammys. [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]

Key Works: Roja, Bombay, Rockstar, Slumdog Millionaire

Anirudh is arguably the most in-demand composer working today. After exploding onto the scene with "Why This Kolaveri Di" in 2012, he has become the driving force behind massive cinematic universes and blockbuster soundtracks. [1, 2]

Key Works: 3, Jailer, Leo, Jawan

3. The Bollywood Staple: Pritam

Pritam Chakraborty is the undisputed king of modern Hindi cinema, known for his ability to craft highly melodic, commercially successful, and chart-topping albums that span multiple genres. [1, 2]

Key Works: Ae Dil Hai Mushkil, Yeh Jawaani Hai Deewani, Brahmāstra

4. The Legendary Maestro: Ilaiyaraaja

Before Rahman, Ilaiyaraaja was the most prolific composer in South India. Having composed over 8,600 songs, he is credited with bringing Western classical harmonies into Indian cinema. [1]

Key Works: Nayakan, Thalapathi, Saagar

5. The International Trailblazer: M.M. Keeravani

@RameshVelliathiam  BC 999's contribution to Raja's tireless service to Indian cinema
 
ILAIYARAAJA-50.  The ONLY composer to have been working nonstop for the past 50 years with consistent output (good music) in a fickle industry.  Remember, unlike others, he was not merely existing in Kodambakkam; it is not even a mere survival.  Hail Maestro.  From AnnakkiLi (1976) to the 2026 latest project under production (Pocket Novel) - he has been making a smooth sailing journey in the turbulent ocean.  Like an eternal spring that never dries up, the forever tree that keeps yielding ripe fruits, a vessel that never empties, his music has been comforting many a soul since the 70s when his entry changed the INDIAN MUSIC scenario in a paradigm shift.  The most deserving candidate for Bharat Ratna (his talent is MORE than the combined prowess of all its previous recipients)!  Wish the Government renames the National award for Best Background Score as 'Maestro Ilaiyaraaja Award', and the State Government names an entire area and a major arterial road in Chennai and Pannaipuram after him. 
 
In 2016, at the Ilayaraja-1000 event organized by Vijay TV, KH said casually, "In another 10 years, IR will be completing 50 years".  Like he promised, he (and the industry) OWES him a complete no-nonsense felicitation ceremony followed by a comprehensive concert spanning months. 
 
6000+ compositions across 7 languages, 1000+ albums with that many Background Scores, in the 50th year of career, collaborating with 600+ producers, 350+ directors, 200+ lyricists, 400+ singers, 3 generations of actors etc. and still very active in his field. With the 2025 Symphony, the OCEAN never dries up. 1st movie in 1976; 500th movie in 1990, and 1000th movie in 2016!  And still manages to give his peers, less than one-third his age, a tough competition via albums like Viduthalai, Modern Love Chennai, Jama etc. LEGACY UNMATCHED; simply peerless. 
 
THE COMPOSER who eats, drinks, sleeps, and breathes MUSIC, for whom music is not a mundane chore or a lucrative career or plain destiny.  One of the GREATEST MINDS ever. MULTI-faceted personality: 360° complete Composer, Lyricist, Singer, Orchestrator, Arranger, Conductor, Score Writer, Photographer, Guitarist, Pianist, editor / screenplay enhancer (Kadalora KavidhaigaL, Sethu, Naan KadavuL songs), VeNbA writer (who taught Vaali), story writer (Naadodi Thendral), almost a director (for Rajadhi Raja).  He has played instruments for some veteran composers during his early years. Listen to IR's wonderful harmonium in songs like Paruvame, Jallantha thullintha (Aathaadi ammaadi), Madai thirandhu etc. That is abundance of talent and GENIUS for O-N-E (1) person! Amply blessed by God, IR still gives nightmares for his "peers" LESS THAN THRICE his AGE via albums like Viduthalai, Modern Love Chennai, Jama, Maayon, Maargazhi ThingaL, Gondhal etc. His discipline, no-nonsense attitude, leadership skill, and work ethics are lessons for everyone.  
IR has a song / piece of music for every emotion and genre, you name it! Like the kid at the largest candy store, each person can have one or more or all of it! Unlike candy, his music is like the most nutritious and delicious soul food.  It doubles as medicine and therapy too. His MUSIC is the driving force behind a song, takes the precedence and is always in the driver's seat - IRRESPECTIVE of the star cast, directors, lyricists or even singers. Most people grew up listening to such songs on the Radio.  So, for a given song, you would not even know who the hero and heroine are, what situation does the song cater to, sometimes even the movie is unknown. His music is not just a healer but also a CONCEALER.  It effortlessly hides the flaws of directors, choreographers, and actors, making even odious situations passable.  
 
Part 2 & 3 will continue..

He has molded singers like SPB, SJ, KJY, Jayachandran, Vani Jairam etc. into stars. Mano, Chitra, Malaysia Vasudevan, Uma Ramanan, Deepan Chakravarthy, Jency, Swarnalatha and several other singers, lyricists, musicians, directors (Bharathi Raja, Balu Mahendra, Mahendran, Mani Ratnam, Bala, Vasanth, Kathir, Suresh Krishna etc.), and producers who were either INTRODUCED or got their first big break or had their career defined by IR music. An excellent TEACHER - ALL his singers’ vocal talents were explored from A-Z without wasting i.e. not with the sole aim of churning out mere hits. He utilized their vocal talent so much to the extent which the singers themselves did not know they were capable of! Many singers and musicians around the world were / still making their living by singing or playing his songs / BGMs! 
 
Chinnappadas song (Kadalora KavidhaigaL), Vaarthai thavarivittaai (Sethu), Isaiyil thodanguthamma (Hey Ram), Maa Ganga (Naan KadavuL), PeN manasu (En Raasaavin Manasile) - all CONCEIVED by ILAYARAJA, composed, written / sung (by him / others) and placed appropriately in those movies! GENIUS is an understatement, and they have the audacity to compare IR with all and sundry. Composer cum music DIRECTOR - only ONE of his KIND.  
Has composed memorable songs for the likes of Manorama, Thenga Srinivasan, Janakaraj, Goundamani, Senthil, Vadivelu, and Kovai Sarala. Asha Bhosle's 1st song in South India, and Lata Mangeshkar's 2nd song in South India (apart from Salil Chowdhury) was for IR. REACH / impact of IR music is tremendous even those days! His song (Aaya hai raja - Appu Raja) is an ESSENTIAL Ganesh Chaturthi song festival in Maharashtra! 
 
RELEVANCE: Sadma, Appu Raja and Thalapathi were pan-Indian albums, with the latter in 1991 kickstarting the cassette boom which latter music directors took advantage of. Many of his songs were copied by Bollywood without any credits whatsoever: Neele neele ambar (iLaya nila), Dhak Dhak (Abbani teeyani), Tu tu tara (Rakkamma kaiya thattu), Saathiya thune kya kiya (Eenaade yedho ayyindhi), Paayalein chunmun (Inji iduppazhagi), Kya mausam (Povoma oorgolam), O Priya (Dil), Ae Zindagi (in Dear Zindagi) etc. Even his Background Scores were taken.  From Kaadhal (2005) to GBU, Retro, Thudarum, Bro Code (2026), 100s of movies have used IR music, either to create HIGH moments for theatre audience, or to evoke nostalgia, or to BOOST an ailing movie!  Ajay-Atul, the Bollywood composer duo, said IR score for Appu Raja (Aboorva SagodharargaL) inspired them to pick music as their career. Ajay said: Until then, I thought music could only make you dance. I never felt that music could make you cry or laugh!  They said one of IR interviews those days led them to explore the likes of Mozart and Beethoven! 
 
From Balamurali Krishna to Pandit Ajoy Chakrabarty, from Bhanumathi / Varalakshmi to Sudha Raghunathan and Bombay Jayashree, from TMS to Sid Sriram, from P. Susheela to Ananya Bhat - IR had everyone singing his tunes!  From Sivakumar to Soori, from actress Sujatha to Bhavani Sri - there is an endless list of actors on whom his songs were picturized.  That includes those from other states as well. IR has co-composed with MSV and Dakshinamurthy - that is how you RESPECT the seniors.  He never shies away from mentioning the name of his mentors like GKV, Dhanraj master, TVG etc.  MANY musicians who worked under him became famous later. Vidyasagar, Deva's brothers, Drums Sivamani to name a few. 
 
Composed for BLOOD STONE (Hollywood), an Australian movie, 6 movies WITHOUT songs, Art films, Documentaries, Broadway Musical, London Olympics, Miss India, Devotional songs for all 3 Religions, plus Symphony.  He also composed the only poem of GANDHI “Namrata ke sagar” that was sung by Ajoy Chakrabarty, Pandit Bhimsen Joshi with narration by Amitabh Bachchan.  He has composed 2 full-fledged Carnatic albums: one with the late Mandolin U. Srinivas, and another one: Swappnam for theater (Bharatanatyam dance-drama). FIRST ASIAN to write a Complete Symphony (1993) with Royal Philharmonic Orchestra of London; composed his second Symphony in 2025; FIRST ASIAN to compose Oratorio (2005 - Thiruvaasagam). 
 
IR is also the PIONEER in Technology: First STEREO introduced in South India (Priya - 1978), FIRST Synthesizer used in India (Punnagai Mannan - 1986), FIRST Computerized music in INDIA (Vikram - 1987) and First time in INDIA to use SYMPHONY orchestra (GURU - 1997 Malayalam).  ONLY composer to compose a song with ONLY 3 NOTES, a whole pallavi with 2 notes, and a 1-note phrase. Creator of the raaga Panchamukhi.  
 
R. D. Burman in 1982 after listening to his song "Yedho mogam" said: IR is ahead of us all by 10 years"!  Salil Chowdhury said, looking at the guitarist in his troupe: This man will be India's greatest composer one day -- That guitarist was none other than ILAYARAJA!  Naushad said in 1986 while launching IR's How to name it album: There is so much to learn from Ilayaraja.  MSV said: I am his fan. Music directors from all over INDIA like Keeravani, DSP, Mani Sharma, Hamsalekha, M. Jayachandran, M.G. Sreekumar, Sean Roldan, Anand-Milind & Ajay-Atul consider Maestro IR as demi-God.  
 
His music is the lifeline of several people across the state - something no other composer could ever dream of.  His achievements are unsurpassable.  That is why he is incomparable.  Would like to know if there is any other musician in the WORLD as prolific as Ilayaraja.
